text:
Arseny Gritsyuk was the 129th pick in 2019, spent years in the KHL, and is now playing real minutes for the Devils. In his second NHL season he has 8 goals and 17 points in 23 games; last season he had 31 in 66.

The tell is five-on-five. With him on the ice New Jersey takes 60% of the shot attempts and 59% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), and the team is better with him than without. Evolving-Hockey had him 1.6 wins above replacement last season, mostly from even-strength offense, so this isn't new, just louder.

Some of the scoring is running hot. He's shooting 15.7% against a likely range near 12%, and the Devils have scored about two more goals than expected with him out there. His last ten games tell the cooler story: two goals, both on October 30 in Vegas, and five assists. Watch him at the offensive blue line. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 54% of his entries last season, and 53% of his shots came off the rush.
headline: Arseny Gritsyuk, a fifth-rounder, keeps tilting the ice
